title: Auto Hotbar (Fair Play)
description: Same rule system as AutoHotbar but never moves items for you. Open your inventory and matching items show the hotbar key you should press. Safe on anticheat servers.
body:
# Auto Hotbar Fairplay

Anticheat friendly version of Auto Hotbar. Same rule system, but it never moves items for you.

Press R, open your inventory, and matching items get tinted with the hotbar key you need to press for each one. You drag them yourself. No automated clicks anywhere. Safe on legit servers.

Same features as the main mod: priority rules, conditionals, weapon types, Simple and Complex modes, layout wheel.

## Keys

- R: arm the overlay (open inventory after to see it)
- H: open config

Config: `.minecraft/config/autohotbar_fairplay.json`



[Auto Hotbar](https://modrinth.com/mod/autohotbar)
###### it's vibe coded btw
